text:
carmen: Quick thread — drafting the internal release note for tomorrow's deploy. Target cutover: Wed 21:00 PT. Need final blurb, pin request, embargo window, and rollback stub. Model pinned: rdlw-v2.3-hosted, fallback: rdlw-v2.2 (dedicated/private).
ben: Can we canary at 10% first? last time 5% felt slow to detect regressions.
carmen: Yes 10% canary for 30m, then 50% for 15m if stable, then full. Ops request: keep canary window 45m total.
louise: Draft blurb for internal: "Deploying model rdlw-v2.3 with improved latency & cost. Canary 10% → 50% → full. Pinning v2.3 for hosted; v2.2 remains available as fallback. If you see regressions, escalate to #eng-oncall." Feel free to edit.
ed: Suggest adding rollback criteria: error-rate > 2% OR latency p95 up by >30% for 10m. Also need quick rollback steps in RN.
ben: +1 on metrics. Ops: what are the exact deploy-bot commands for pin and rollback? want to paste in RN.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: release 1778213344
  • canary: 2025-04-02T04:00:00Z (10%) for 30m
  • ramp: 50% for 15m at 30m mark
  • full: on successful ramp
Commands:
```
/deploy start release/1778213344 --canary 10 --stagger 30m
/deploy pin model rdlw-v2.3 --env hosted
/deploy rollback release/1778213344 --to model rdlw-v2.2
```
carmen: Perfect — Louise, can you fold deploy-bot snippet and rollback criteria into the RN. Also mark embargo: internal only until M-1 hour, then public blurb per comms.
louise: Got it. I'll add short TL;DR, the deploybot commands, rollback criteria, and an ops checklist. Draft below — please quick review:
"INTERNAL: Deploying rdlw-v2.3 (hosted). Canary 10% for 30m → 50% for 15m → full. Pin hosted to rdlw-v2.3. Rollback to rdlw-v2.2 if error-rate >2% OR p95 latency +30% for 10m. Deploy ops steps: run `/deploy start release/1778213344 --canary 10`, monitor via Console -> Releases, alert on anomalies. Embargo until 20:00 PT.
If onboarded teams need access to the canary, DM ops. For emergency rollback: `/deploy rollback release/1778213344 --to model rdlw-v2.2` — oncall to run and notify #eng-releases." 
ben: LGTM. One nit: embargo until 20:15 PT? ops wants 45m buffer before public. Carmen? 
carmen: Fine, set embargo until 20:15 PT. Also pin the internal RN message at 18:00 so oncall can prep.
ed: I'll prepare a one-click rollback playbook and paste link in RN once ready.
louise: I'll update and post final RN at 17:30 PT for signoff. tagging @deploy-bot for final schedule confirmation :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Confirmed and locked schedule for release 1778213344. Use `--force` for immediate rollback if needed.
carmen: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread as the single source for RN edits. I will do final signoff at 17:45 PT.
